Problem Statement:
Given a string S and a number K. Print all the substrings of S of length K(space separeted output). 
Input Description:
|S| <= 100 and K<= 50 
Output Description:
All substrings of S of length K, space separated. 
Sample Input:
prog 2 
Sample Output:
pr ro og
